name: Ramai Awas Yojana (Rural & Urban Housing for SC/Neo-Buddhist, Maharashtra)
benefit: Financial assistance for construction of a permanent (pucca) house for Scheduled Caste and Neo-Buddhist families in Maharashtra, implemented since 2010-11: Rs 1.32 lakh in rural areas and Rs 1.42 lakh in hilly/Naxal-affected areas (both including Rs 12,000 for toilet construction), and Rs 2.50 lakh in urban areas (Municipal Council/Nagar Parishad and Municipal Corporation areas).
eligibility_rules: Beneficiary must belong to the Scheduled Castes or Neo-Buddhist category
Must have resided in Maharashtra for at least 15 years
Only one person per family can receive the benefit
Beneficiary must own a plot of land or a temporary (kutcha) house on which the pucca house will be built
Annual family income must not exceed Rs 1.20 lakh in rural areas or Rs 3.00 lakh in urban areas
Beneficiary should be OUTSIDE the SECC 2011 priority list criteria (the scheme targets SC/Neo-Buddhist families not covered under PMAY-G's SECC-based selection)

Rural selection: by the Gram Sabha, finalized by the House Construction Committee chaired by the CEO, Zilla Parishad; Urban selection: by the committee chaired by the Municipal Commissioner (Corporations) or District Collector (Councils/Nagar Panchayats)
Slum-dweller relaxation: per GR dated 15/03/2016, the 7/12 land-record requirement is relaxed for protected slum dwellers residing on government/municipal/MMRDA land since 01/01/1995
exclusions: Families that have already availed benefits from any other housing scheme are not eligible
Persons not belonging to SC/Neo-Buddhist category are not covered (other categories have separate schemes like PMAY-G or Shabari Awas for ST)
Family income above Rs 1.20 lakh (rural) / Rs 3.00 lakh (urban) disqualifies
Residence in Maharashtra for less than 15 years disqualifies
More than one beneficiary per family is not allowed
Beneficiaries without any plot or temporary house of their own (unless covered by the slum-dweller relaxation) are not eligible
documents_required: Land/property proof: 7/12 extract, Property Registered Card, or Gram Panchayat property register extract (relaxed for protected slum dwellers per GR 15/03/2016)
House tax, water tax, or electricity bill (any one)
Caste certificate from a competent authority (SC/Neo-Buddhist)
Income certificate from a competent authority
Voter list extract as of 01/01/1995 and Election Voter ID card
Property tax payment receipt (for urban/municipal areas)
how_to_apply: Rural: apply through your Gram Panchayat - beneficiary selection happens via the Gram Sabha and is finalized by the Zilla Parishad House Construction Committee. Urban: apply through the Municipal Corporation/Council, where the committee chaired by the Commissioner or District Collector selects beneficiaries. Contact the local Social Justice department office or Gram Panchayat/municipal office to get on the list.
source_document: Maharashtra Social Justice & Special Assistance Department - Ramai Awas Yojana; GR No. VISAA-2015/PR.NO.85/CONSTRUCTION dated 15/03/2016
